query: INSERT INTO phase_outputs(project_id,attempt_id,stage,status,revision,front_matter,body,sha256,via_channel,via_client,origin,source_ref) VALUES($1,$2,'writeup','completed',1,jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('kind',$3::text,'author',$4::text,'written_on',$5::date,'written_at',$6::timestamptz)),$7,$8,'cli','cannery import','imported',$9) RETURNING id AS "id: uuid::Uuid"
